channel.title: Frontify incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Frontify's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Asset processing and delivery broken for some assets [resolved]
item.description: After AWS reported that all issues had been resolved, we were able to migrate the delivery and processing of assets back to the US for US hosted customers this morning.

item.title: Partial outage due to AWS issue - SelfService [resolved]
Partial outage due to AWS issue [resolved]
item.description:
We recently experienced a partial outage caused by a global Amazon Web Services (AWS) issue. This led to temporary disruption of file processing and degraded performance across some other functionalities.
AWS has since mitigated the issue, and all Frontify services are now fully operational.
If you continue to experience any issues, please contact our support team at support@frontify.com.
